intro: Oil and gas made Equatorial Guinea one of Africa's richest countries per person, but most people remain poor.

chapters.title: Oil
text: Oil and gas make up almost all exports. Output is falling as fields age.

chapters.title: Cocoa
text: Cocoa from Bioko was once the main export.

keyTerms.meaning: A big gap between rich and poor.

cardGroups.title: Made in Equatorial Guinea
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Equatorial Guinea makes and sells to the world.
